existing_features.title: Remove the "Admin Special Password" / "Access Code" field and all related UI copy from the signup completion form, so users can complete signup after selecting a role without entering any extra code.

Remove frontend validation and error messaging logic that enforces or references the admin/engineer code requirement (including the 6-digit code validation and any translated backend error messages specific to invalid/missing codes).
Update the frontend signup mutation call to stop sending any access code value during signup (send null/omit according to the generated candid bindings), consistent with removing the access-code UI.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove authorization system (no Internet Identity requirement / disable sign-in gating)
Remove "Admin special Password" and "Access code" mechanisms

Update the backend signup flow to eliminate the Admin/Engineer secret code checks, so signupWithRole no longer traps for missing/invalid adminCode and does not compare against any hardcoded code values.

projectName: Remove Admin Special Password and Access Code from signup
